response.rationale: The item is electronics with days_since_delivery = 16, which is greater than 15. RET-003 (priority 20) applies and dominates the standard 30-day window rule RET-007 (priority 10). The item is not final sale, not defective, no goodwill grant, and no fraud hold, so no higher-priority rule applies. Electronics returns are not accepted after 15 days.
